title: OntoAR-HAR: Ontology-Guided Agentic RAG with Personalized Memory for Human Activity Recognition

claim.summary: OntoAR-HAR has an LLM descend a confusion-guided activity ontology, choosing a child at each node from node-constrained population and personal retrieval plus executable feature reports, and adds accepted query windows to a per-user memory through an agreement gate.

modules.name: Ontology-guided node-constrained retrieval and traversal
modules.scope_reason: The decision path, retrieval mask and node instructions are defined by the activity-label ontology, so the mechanism is tied to the HAR label output.

modules.name: Gated personalized episodic memory
modules.scope_reason: The store keeps a user's earlier windows paired with accepted activity labels and admits them through label- and node-feature agreement checks, so memory content and gate are bound to the classification output.

modules.name: LLM iterative executable feature construction
modules.scope_reason: Proposed signal features are executed and scored by how well they separate child activities on retrieval-only misclassifications, so the loop's objective is tied to activity-node decisions.
